text.p: Graff Pay-Per-View Inc said on Friday that its president and chief operating officer Edward Spector had resigned to head one of the company's units.
Graff said in a statement that Chairman and Chief Executive Officer J. Roger Faherty would act as interim president.
Spector would return to manage the daily operations of the company's Spector Entertainment Group, but would retain his board seat, it said.

The adult television entertainment programming provider also said its board asked for a review of options for the potential sale of its satellite simulcasting and television production services. This was part of its strategy to focus on its core adult entertainment business, the company said.
"Graff will continue to focus on diversifying and globalizing its 'SPICE' adult entertainment brand," Faherty said.
Steve Saril, president of the Spice Networks unit, had been elected to the board, it said.
